task.title: P6-155: Add aria-expanded to both kebab menu triggers
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-155. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**Neither kebab trigger sets `aria-expanded`, so a screen reader cannot tell the shared panel is open** (was `P6-017e` + `P6-024h`). `HeaderKebab` (`collection.rs:806`) and the tree row's `⋯` (`tree.rs:503-506`) both set `aria-haspopup="menu"` and neither sets `aria-expanded` — **fix both together**, since fixing one of two consumers is its own inconsistency, which is why neither has it.
